beats.text: Sanjeevani grew on a faraway mountain in the Himalayas. Hanuman flew there in a single night, faster than the wind.
He crossed rivers, forests and kingdoms, until the white peaks of the Himalayas shone below him.
But the mountain glowed with countless herbs, and he could not tell which was the right one. The herbs hid themselves from him.
So Hanuman lifted the whole mountain and carried it across the sky.
He flew back over India and the sea, holding the glowing mountain in his hand like a lamp.
Sushena found the herb, crushed it, and held it to Lakshmana's nose. Lakshmana opened his eyes just before dawn.
Rama embraced him, weeping with joy. The monkey army shouted until Lanka shook.
Then Hanuman carried the mountain back to where it belonged, before the sun rose.
